primary_products: SAP Datasphere (formerly SAP Data Warehouse Cloud) — cloud-native, unified data experience on SAP BTP; supports data federation, data cataloging, semantic modeling, zero-copy architecture
SAP BW/4HANA — on-premise/private cloud data warehouse; mature, structured, SAP-centric; can coexist with Datasphere in hybrid scenarios
SAP HANA Cloud — in-memory cloud database underlying Datasphere and BW/4HANA Cloud
SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) — launched Feb 2025; fully managed SaaS platform bundling Datasphere + SAP Analytics Cloud + BW/4HANA private cloud + SAP Databricks
SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) — BI/analytics front-end, integrates tightly with Datasphere for planning
key_facts_to_verify: SAP Datasphere pricing: ~USD 12–15 per capacity unit/year; minimum ~4,300 CUs for enterprise. Researcher must confirm current pricing.
SAP Business Data Cloud launched February 2025 — bundles Datasphere + SAC + BW/4HANA private cloud + SAP Databricks. Researcher confirms scope.
BDC Connect for Databricks GA October 2025; Google BigQuery and Snowflake integrations H1 2026; Microsoft Fabric Q3 2026. Researcher verifies dates.
SAP BW/4HANA end-of-mainstream-maintenance: researcher must confirm current SAP guidance (important for BW customers considering migration to Datasphere).
UU PDP (UU No. 27 Tahun 2022): personal data protection law; PDP Agency expected operational 2026. Researcher confirms current status.
